messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — need to lock down the staggered beta cadence and acceptance gates for the Peregrine Health pilot. key asks: recruitment targets, feedback channels, and scope tradeoffs. who has bandwidth today?
Juan (Eng): I can take the recruitment targets. are we doing 3 cohorts (pilot, early, open) or a rolling window?
Kevin (Solutions): prefer 3 cohorts with 2-week observation windows per cohort. gives time for telemetry + quick fixes. :thumbsup:
Lina (Research): agree. we should define the eval set per cohort. small canonical prompts + 10 real customer flows.
Maya (PM): sounds good. proposed targets: cohort A=8 clinical seats, cohort B=20 product seats, cohort C=open waitlist. acceptance gate = no P0 regressions on eval set, <3% hallucination on critical fields.
Juan (Eng): technical note: to enforce <3% we need token-level traces + schema checks. ops-bot will need retention/ingest policy.
ops-bot: FYI — default telemetry retention is 90d. if you need longer, file a request to infra-telemetry.
Kevin (Solutions): recruitment questions — are we focusing customers with on-prem or hosted? Peregrine needs VPC, so first cohort must be private deploy. that narrows pool.
Maya (PM): good catch. Cohort A private-only, Cohorts B/C can be hosted. update recruitment brief accordingly.
Lina (Research): feedback loops: prefer a 3-tier funnel: quick pulse survey (in-app), structured bug form (with example artifacts), and scheduled 30m weekly synthesis with partner leads.
Kevin (Solutions): add runbook: if partner reports data-sensitivity concern, enable redaction + disable app logs until reviewed. minimal config toggle.
Maya (PM): draft acceptance criteria snippet for legal/ops review:
```
- Security: private deployment + KMS key in partner account for Cohort A
- Reliability: 99.5% availability target during scheduled business hours
- Quality: evaluation pass rate >= 92% on canonical eval set
- Feedback: partner submits at least 5 annotated examples per week during cohort A
```
Juan (Eng): availability SLA — we can promise 99.5% on Dedicated capacity but not on early private installs until infra baseline is validated. propose soft-SLA during cohort A.
Maya (PM): noted. we'll call it "availability objective" for cohort A and formal SLA from cohort B.
Lina (Research): telemetry hooks — include these fields in feedback payload: input_id, anonymized_user_id, model_variant, eval_label, notes. sample payload: `{input_id: 1234, variant: "q4-8bit", label: "ok/issue"}`
Kevin (Solutions): also add a "rollback trigger": if more than 5 critical bugs reported within 72h, we revert to previous model and open incident channel.
Maya (PM): agreed. add escalation path and timeline to the recruitment pitch (so partners know fallthrough).
Juan (Eng): timeline ask: can Eng commit to a hotfix window of 48h for cohort A? we need to ensure on-call coverage.
Kevin (Solutions): Solutions can cover partner-facing coordination nights, Eng on-call rota needed. ops-bot — confirm on-call rotation status.
ops-bot: on-call rota: eng-night oncall available Wed-Fri nights for next 6 weeks. file incident if emergency.
Maya (PM): action items (short):
- Juan: finalize recruitment counts + private deploy checklist (due EOD Wed)
- Lina: finalize eval set + 10 real flows (due Thu)
- Kevin: update partner pitch with rollback/escalation text (due Thu)
- Maya: draft legal intro for KMS + data retention and push to partners (due Fri)
- Ops: confirm telemetry retention exception if needed (blocker)
Kevin (Solutions): I'll ping Peregrine to confirm private infra constraints and get a list of their infra contacts.
Lina (Research): once eval set locked, I'll create a small script to auto-run the checks and produce weekly delta reports.
Juan (Eng): will also add a quick health check endpoint for cohort A to capture latency percentiles per route.
Maya (PM): thanks all. one more: recruitment incentive — offer 3 months of discounted Dedicated pricing for Cohort A participants. sound reasonable?
Kevin (Solutions): good incentive. helps offset private setup effort.
Lina (Research): can we measure ROI per partner? baseline metrics: tokens/day, avg latency, annotated issues/week.
Maya (PM): yes — include a short KPI dashboard template in the partner pack.
Juan (Eng): ok, I'll start the private-deploy checklist PR and tag you all.
Maya (PM): closing — i'll compile notes and send a short partner-facing one-pager. ping me with anything missing. :rocket:
